nodes.label: DEALS: synthetic ledger of 20 open deals and 73 hand-labelled events
nodes.rationale: The benchmark ledger, $2.79M of pipeline. Events follow the AckDB ledger format: subject first, a typed prefix on anything that is not a person doing something, raw timestamps, provider in brackets. D01 to D05 rebuild the five deals on AckDB's at-risk demo screen (Datacore, Cloudmark, Ironbridge, Precision, Vantage) so each reason has to be earned from events. The rest, and every person, are made up. Each event is (id, timestamp, source, text, signal, severity, exec_engaged) and each deal carries expect, the verdict it was written to have.

nodes.label: Answer key self-check: hand labels must reproduce each deal's intended verdict
nodes.rationale: Each deal carries expect, the verdict it was meant to have. ledger.main() runs spec.assess over the hand labels and exits without a usable dataset if any deal disagrees, so a labelling slip fails loudly instead of quietly moving a benchmark number.
